rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Create, drop, rename, move, authorize, and change ownership of schemas.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Create, drop, rename, move, persist/unpersist, and change ownership of tables; cover ordinary, unlogged, temporary-boundary, partitioned, inherited, typed, foreign, and identity-bearing tables where in scope.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Add, drop, rename, reorder-only, and batch columns on empty and populated tables.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Change data type with implicit cast, assignment cast, explicit USING, lossy conversion, incompatible conversion, arrays, domains, enums, and collation changes.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Add/change/drop defaults, including volatile defaults and expression defaults; verify existing rows are not rewritten incorrectly.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Add/drop NOT NULL with and without valid data and with staged validation.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Add/change/drop identity and generated expressions; switch identity ALWAYS/BY DEFAULT; restart and change sequence options.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Change compression, storage, statistics target, column options, and per-column privileges.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Sequence create/drop/rename/move; type, increment, min/max, cache, cycle, restart, owned-by, and ownership changes.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Table access method, tablespace, persistence, storage parameters, replica identity, row-security flags, clustering, and inheritance changes.

rows.heading: Schemas, tables, columns, and sequences
rows.text: Preserve rows containing NULLs, defaults, arrays, JSON, bytea, large text, generated values, identity values, and boundary numeric/time values.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Composite keys; self, cyclic, multi-column, cross-schema, partitioned, and deferrable foreign keys; action and match-mode changes.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: NOT VALID creation followed by VALIDATE CONSTRAINT, including invalid existing data.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Attach an existing unique index as a constraint and detach or replace it without needless rebuilds.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Index create/drop/rename/move and changes to uniqueness, method, columns, expressions, sort order, NULLS order, INCLUDE, predicate, collation, operator class, options, tablespace, and validity.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Partial, expression, covering, multicolumn, partitioned, hash, GiST, SP-GiST, GIN, BRIN, and extension-provided indexes.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Concurrent-index policy, invalid indexes, clustered indexes, replica identity indexes, and duplicate-equivalent definitions.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Extended statistics create/drop/rename and changes to columns, kinds, target, owner, and schema.

rows.heading: Constraints, indexes, statistics, and rules
rows.text: Rewrite rules create/replace/drop/enable/disable and interaction with views, triggers, and RLS.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: RANGE, LIST, HASH, DEFAULT, multilevel, and subpartitioned hierarchies.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: Add, detach, finalize detach, attach, rename, move, and drop partitions.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: Change bounds, default-partition constraints, partition keys, and strategy through safe staged operations or explicit refusal.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: Attach populated tables with validated constraints and reject overlapping or invalid data.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: Local versus partitioned indexes, attached indexes, constraints, sequences, triggers, RLS, publications, and foreign keys.

rows.heading: Partitions and inheritance
rows.text: Traditional inheritance add/drop parent, multiple inheritance, NO INHERIT, and inherited column/constraint behavior.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Enum create/drop/rename/move; add value before/after, rename value, reorder request, delete request, and transactional/version limitations.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Domain base type, default, NOT NULL, collation, and named check-constraint transitions with populated dependent columns.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Composite type attributes add/drop/rename/type/collation changes and dependent tables/functions.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Range and multirange creation, rename, move, subtype/opclass/canonical/diff changes, and dependencies.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Base and shell types, input/output/receive/send/analyze/subscript functions, storage/alignment/category/preference/collatability changes.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Cast create/drop and changes to function, context, and method.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Operator, operator class, operator family, aggregate, and support-function dependency transitions.

rows.heading: Types, domains, ranges, and casts
rows.text: Positive CREATE TRANSFORM coverage plus replace/drop and language/type dependencies.

rows.heading: Views and materialized views
rows.text: Create/replace/drop/rename/move and ownership, comment, ACL, security barrier/invoker, check option, and column-name changes.

rows.heading: Views and materialized views
rows.text: Compatible and incompatible output-column changes; nested, recursive, lateral, aggregate, window, set-operation, and cross-schema views.

rows.heading: Views and materialized views
rows.text: Dependency-safe ordering when base objects and view chains change together.

rows.heading: Views and materialized views
rows.text: Materialized-view query, options, tablespace, access method, index, owner, populated/unpopulated state, refresh, and concurrent-refresh eligibility.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: SQL, PL/pgSQL, and supported extension-language routines.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Create/replace/drop/rename/move; signature, argument name/mode/default, return type/table, language, body, volatility, strictness, leakproofness, parallel safety, security mode, support function, cost, rows, configuration, owner, ACL, and dependency changes.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Overloads, variadic/polymorphic arguments, quoted bodies, dollar-tag variants, comments, whitespace, and CRLF-versus-LF normalization.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Procedure transaction behavior and IN/OUT signature transitions.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Ordinary, ordered-set, and hypothetical-set aggregate transitions, including state/combine/serial/deserial/final/moving functions.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Row, statement, constraint, INSTEAD OF, transition-table, deferred, partitioned-table, enabled/disabled, and replica/always triggers.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Event-trigger create/drop/rename/enable changes for ddl_command_start, ddl_command_end, table_rewrite, and sql_drop, with tag filtering.

rows.heading: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers
rows.text: Safe ordering when a routine is used by a default, generated column, index, constraint, policy, trigger, view, operator, cast, or publication filter.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: Role create/drop/rename and LOGIN, SUPERUSER, CREATEDB, CREATEROLE, REPLICATION, BYPASSRLS, connection limit, validity, password-redaction, and membership/admin/inherit/set option transitions.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: Object ownership changes and DROP OWNED/REASSIGN OWNED boundaries.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: GRANT/REVOKE for schemas, tables, columns, sequences, routines, types, databases, tablespaces, foreign objects, large objects, and parameters.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: Grant option, PUBLIC, default privileges, grantor identity, duplicate grants, and revoke cascade/restrict.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: RLS enable/disable/force/no-force; policy create/drop/rename and changes to command, permissive/restrictive mode, roles, USING, and WITH CHECK.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: Policies using auth.uid(), auth.jwt(), security-definer helpers, views, joins, custom claims, anonymous/authenticated/service roles, and recursive policy hazards.

rows.heading: Roles, ownership, grants, and row-level security
rows.text: Ensure routine security, search_path, ownership, privileges, and RLS are changed in a non-exploitable order.

rows.heading: Publications and logical replication
rows.text: Publication create/drop/rename/owner, FOR ALL TABLES, selected tables, schema membership, column lists, row filters, publish operations, partition root, and membership add/drop.

rows.heading: Publications and logical replication
rows.text: Supabase Realtime publication membership and replica-identity requirements.

rows.heading: Publications and logical replication
rows.text: Subscription definitions, connection-string redaction, enabled state, slot/publication changes, origin, streaming, binary, two-phase, failover, refresh, skip, and DROP cleanup when a safe test environment supports them.

rows.heading: Publications and logical replication
rows.text: Slot/origin/runtime replication state is asserted separately from declarative DDL.

rows.heading: Text search, collations, conversions, and languages
rows.text: Text-search parser, template, dictionary, and configuration lifecycle; token mappings and dependency ordering.

rows.heading: Text search, collations, conversions, and languages
rows.text: Collation create/drop/rename/move, provider, locale/rules, deterministic flag, encoding, version refresh, ICU/libc availability, and OS drift.

rows.heading: Text search, collations, conversions, and languages
rows.text: Conversion create/drop/rename/move/default and source/destination encoding/function changes.

rows.heading: Text search, collations, conversions, and languages
rows.text: Procedural-language create/drop/rename/owner/handler/validator/inline transitions and trusted/untrusted boundaries.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: Extension create/drop, version upgrade/downgrade request, schema move, cascade policy, relocatable/non-relocatable behavior, and configuration-table membership.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: Extension-owned objects are neither duplicated nor accidentally dropped; user modifications and upgrade conflicts produce useful diagnostics.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: Foreign-data wrapper, server, user mapping, and foreign-table create/drop/rename/move plus handler/validator/options/owner/ACL changes.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: Add/change/drop options with correct SET/ADD/DROP syntax and redact passwords, tokens, URLs, and connection strings from reports.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, unavailable endpoints, changed remote schemas, local test servers, and failure recovery.

rows.heading: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries
rows.text: Security labels and providers, including pgsodium availability and unsupported-provider diagnostics.

rows.heading: Explicit PostgreSQL boundaries
rows.text: Access methods, transforms, extended statistics, rules, event triggers, subscriptions, large objects, database-level settings, and parameter grants.

rows.heading: Explicit PostgreSQL boundaries
rows.text: Database and tablespace creation, which may require connections, privileges, and transaction boundaries outside a normal project migration.

rows.heading: Explicit PostgreSQL boundaries
rows.text: Temporary/session objects, runtime sequence values, materialized-view contents, replication slots, prepared transactions, and statistics, which are state rather than portable schema.

rows.heading: Explicit PostgreSQL boundaries
rows.text: Cluster-level roles/settings and superuser-only features.

rows.heading: Explicit PostgreSQL boundaries
rows.text: Unsupported object kinds fail with a stable, actionable diagnostic and do not silently disappear from the declarative export.
